verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a full public API reference for managing projects, experiments, datasets, prompts, scorers, and logging programmatically (braintrust-docs-11, -34), backed by SDKs (braintrust-gh-1/2), a CLI (braintrust-docs-33), and MCP server for agent-driven access (braintrust-docs-9, -25). Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (braintrust-probe-3 shows 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond docs.
